active_work_item.reason: PM architecture decision after repeated AC4 escalation: replace free-form inference prose plus self-declared InferenceBasis with a closed structured inference proposition as canonical truth. Builder must define a bounded provider-neutral proposition union whose variant determines subject and interpretation by construction; provenance references must resolve to canonical nodes already typed/bound to that same subject. User-facing inference title/explanation must be rendered deterministically from the structured proposition (or validated as renderer output), never accepted as an independent semantic assertion. Remove global cross-subject condition allow-list behavior and do not add lexical/topic/prose heuristics. Required deterministic regressions: scheduling condition cannot produce vendor-unreliable proposition; scheduling condition cannot be relabelled payment/total/fees/scope/etc unless its canonical typed node is that subject; compatible timeline scheduling inference passes; descriptor/prose drift is impossible or hard-fails; unsupported inference with unrelated provenance fails; preserve all prior CP7 fixtures including not_stated/excluded, mixed risk dimensions, uncertainty, arithmetic, fabricated charge/fact, contradictory evidence, and no-material-concern. Keep changes bounded to CP7 trust contracts/evaluator/fixtures/minimal type-rendering wiring. Exact PR-head install/lint/typecheck/tests/evals/build required before QA. No paid/live eval, YELLOW/RED action, production mutation, or scope expansion authorized.
